note: EXEC-SCREENER-FLOW-CANDLES P5 (verification/screener/P5_FLOW.md section 2): the output kind of every output of the Terminal's 48 flow indicators (flowRegistry.json), from EXEC.md "Cakupan flow" (K continuous normalised, P percentile or z-score, Rp rupiah or another amount, L lots per transaction, H price level, D day count, F 0/1 signal, B broker count) and OPERATORS.md section 4, and the ADV liquidity floor flag (EXEC.md: FL03-FL06, FL08, FL10, FL13-FL15, FL36, FL46). The operators block of screener-metrics.json reads the kinds (measures and tests not offered on a kind: rank and percentile-type measures not on H, = and != only on D, F and B, K7). An output is a kind letter, {"kind", "unit"} (a unit other than the registry's), or {"by": <parameter>, <option>: ...} when the kind follows a parameter. requires: data the Screener does not hold (insider). The screener registry generator (scripts/build-screener-registry.mjs) refuses an indicator or output without a row. P5b (P5_FLOW.md section 3): `screener` on a row is the Screener's version of that indicator (compute: how the core computes it on top of the Terminal's computeFlow; replace: registry parameters replaced in place by the parameters listed, an empty list drops one; add: parameters appended; replace_outputs: the outputs below replace the registry's; formula and misuse: the catalog's words); `screener_params` the parameters several rows share; `screener_entries` the Screener's own flow entries that are not a Terminal indicator. A maximum "window" is the broker window (window_sessions), "window-1" one less.
window_note: K1 (user 2026-11-07): the broker window the publisher writes (P4 BROKER_DAY_SESSIONS = 60); the window a built-in baseline left out is capped to when the caller names no loaded window (the worker always names its own).

FL23.note: The Screener's version of Broker Inventory (decision B, user 2026-11-07; OPERATORS.md section 4 row B): one series over the holders (series a the inventory over the lookback, b the daily net, c the inventory as a percent of the lookback's traded value) and the count of holders that moved (output count, B). The Terminal's one line per broker and their total are not a condition series.

brokers.label: Holders
brokers.text: Top-K: at each session the K brokers with the largest positive inventory over the lookback (ties by broker code); selected: the brokers named; all: every broker with a row in the loaded window.

brokers.label: Brokers
brokers.text: Read with holders "Selected brokers": 1 to 5 broker codes.

brokers.label: Top K
brokers.text: Read with holders "Top-K holders" (the Terminal draws at most 5 brokers).

view.label: Series
options: c · Inventory ÷ traded value of the lookback (%)
view.text: a: the Terminal's cumulative inventory counted from the first of the lookback's sessions; b: the Terminal's daily net; c: a as a percent of every investor's traded value on the chosen boards over the same sessions.

view.label: Lookback (sessions)
view.text: The L sessions ending at the evaluated candle: the inventory counts from the first of them; Top-K holders are ranked on it; series c divides by their traded value.

add.label: Holders that moved: by at least
add.text: Read by output count, in the series' unit: lots or rupiah for a and b, percent of the traded value for c; a holder counts when its series is above 0 and at least this (rose) or below 0 and at most minus this (fell).

screener.formula: Series a: the Terminal's Broker Inventory (cumulative net lots or rupiah) of each holder, counted from the first of the last L sessions, summed over the holders; b: the Terminal's daily net of the holders; c: 100 x the holders' inventory over the L sessions / every investor's traded value (gross buy) on the chosen boards over the same sessions. Holders: the K brokers with the largest positive inventory over the L sessions, the brokers named, or every broker. Output count: how many holders' series rose (fell) by at least the amount.
screener.misuse: An inventory is a net of the broker's clients over the sessions counted, not a holding: it starts at zero on the first of them. Series a and b scale with the stock's size (use c to compare stocks).

anchor_sessions.label: Anchor: sessions before the evaluated candle
anchor_sessions.text: The anchor is the candle N sessions before the candle being evaluated, found per stock on its own sessions; the value reads those N + 1 sessions, ranks a Top-N cohort over them only, and is missing when the anchor falls before the stock's first session with broker data.

fnet.name: Foreign Net Value
fnet.tip: Foreign investors' net buying (buy value minus sell value) in rupiah over the last sessions.
fnet.formula: Sum over the last D sessions of the buy value minus the sell value of every broker row with investor type Foreign on the chosen boards (every board by default), in rupiah; missing unless the session has broker data and the D sessions start at or after the stock's first session with broker data.
fnet.misuse: Investor type, not broker domicile. A rupiah amount grows with the stock's size (Net Flow / Turnover Ratio with all brokers and Foreign investors compares stocks). One Nego block can dominate on every board.
fnet.note: Old FL01 fnet (AUDIT.md 16.5), kept as a screener entry (user 2026-11-07, "Rumus lama"): no Terminal indicator gives the rupiah foreign net. The board default stays every board (the old definition).

ksei_net.name: Major-Holder Net Change (KSEI)
ksei_net.tip: Net change of the 5% holders' stakes reported to KSEI over the last sessions.
ksei_net.formula: Sum of the KSEI-reported changes (percentage points of the shares) of the stock's major holders with a position date in the last D sessions.
ksei_net.misuse: KSEI dates are position-report dates and many prices are estimates; not point-in-time for past dates.
ksei_net.note: Old FL20's major-holder part (AUDIT.md 16.5), kept REQUIRES_DATA: no KSEI file is published to the Screener (user 2026-11-07: "FL31 dan KSEI nanti saja").
